videos.title: Beginners Should Think Differently When Writing Golang
videos.description: This video teaches beginners how to approach Go language development with an alternative mindset, focusing on efficient and idiomatic patterns for writing clean, maintainable code using core Go concepts.

videos.title: Unleash a SIMPLE REST API with Golang Gin Framework!
videos.description: This video demonstrates how to build a basic REST API using the Gin web framework in Golang. It covers the fundamental steps and concepts for creating a functional API with Go and Gin.

videos.title: Everything I did to become an expert in Golang (you can do this too)
videos.description: The video outlines a four-year journey from beginner to expert in Go, detailing learning strategies and experiences. It covers critical steps viewers can follow to master Golang development.

videos.title: Python (FastAPI) vs Go (Golang) Performance Benchmark
videos.description: Explore a detailed performance benchmark comparing Python's FastAPI with the Go standard library in a production-ready environment. This analysis evaluates two test scenarios deployed on Kubernetes in AWS. The first test establishes a baseline by measuring latency, throughput…

videos.title: Go Gin REST API Tutorial
videos.description: Learn to build a powerful REST API in Go with the Gin web framework. This tutorial guides you through the fundamentals of creating a Go web application, starting from project setup with Go modules to building a functional API. You will discover how to define routes for various…

videos.title: Go (Golang) Performance Benchmark (gnet vs fiber vs fasthttp vs net/http)
videos.description: This video benchmarks Go web frameworks and servers, including gin, gnet, fiber, fasthttp, and net/http. It compares their performance in various scenarios, providing insights into their efficiency for Go applications and database interactions with Postgres.

videos.title: Golang Gin Framework Crash Course 03 | Data Binding and Validation
videos.description: This video explores data binding and validation within the Gin HTTP web framework for Go. It covers how to handle incoming data and ensure its integrity in web applications.

videos.title: Golang / Go Gin Framework Crash Course 02 |  Middlewares 101: Authorization, Logging and Debugging
videos.description: Learn to implement and customize essential middleware in your Go applications using the Gin web framework. This guide walks you through creating three crucial middlewares from scratch and using built-in Gin helpers. You'll master custom logging by formatting log output with…

videos.title: File Uploads in Go/Gin (AWS S3 uploads and save to disk)
videos.description: This video details file uploads within a Go/Gin application. It covers methods for uploading images from an HTML form to an AWS S3 bucket using the AWS SDK for Go v2, and demonstrates saving files directly to disk.

videos.title: Golang / Go Gin Framework Crash Course 04 | HTML, Templates and Multi-Route Grouping
videos.description: This video explores integrating HTML and templates, alongside multi-route grouping, within applications built using the Gin HTTP web framework in Go.

videos.title: Golang Gin Framework Crash Course 09 | Setting up a JSON Web Token (JWT) Authorization Middleware
videos.description: This video covers implementing JSON Web Token (JWT) authorization middleware within a Go Gin framework application. It explores JWT principles and demonstrates their application to secure API endpoints.

videos.title: Swagger API Documentation with Swaggo in Golang
videos.description: This video explains how to generate Swagger API documentation in Golang using Swaggo. It covers Swaggo library basics, integration with a Go Fiber application, and documenting GET and POST endpoints.

videos.title: Golang Gin Framework Crash Course 05 | Deployment on AWS with Elastic Beanstalk (bonus: IAM setup)
videos.description: This video explains how to deploy a Go Gin framework application to AWS Elastic Beanstalk. It covers the necessary IAM setup for the deployment process, demonstrating the steps to configure and launch an application on the AWS platform.
